name: peckboard-story-writer
description: PeckBoard plugin: a per-project Story tab that runs a setup wizard (premise, plot, characters, relationships, themes, endings, style rules, banned words — each 'I write it' / 'AI drafts, I edit' / 'AI generates') and then a chaptered writing pipeline (pilot chapter -> owner review gate -> parallel chapters -> structure/character/pacing/line/copyedit review passes -> export), driving it with cards (peckboard_create_card / peckboard_update_card) and worker MCP tools (story_get_brief, story_get_records, story_submit_records, story_submit_chapter, story_update_state, story_report_review).

scripts.build: node esbuild.js && extism-js dist/index.js -i src/index.d.ts -o dist/plugin.wasm
